values.meaning: duration bonus persists after leaving brush (Ivern)
values.quote: This bonus persists for 3 seconds after leaving brush.

values.meaning: duration bonus persists after leaving brush (ally)
values.quote: This bonus persists for {{fd|1.5}} seconds after leaving brush.

mechanics.claim: While Ivern is in brush, his basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing additional magic damage.
mechanics.quote: While '''Ivern''' is in {{tip|brush}}, his basic attacks are empowered to fire a bolt at the target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The additional on-hit damage does not apply to structures.
mechanics.quote: The additional damage does not apply to structures.

mechanics.claim: Allied champions in brush within ~1000 units of Ivern get the same on-hit empowerment, which respects enchantment redirection.
mechanics.quote: The empowerment given to allies respects {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
